note: Repository-wide exceptions per §11. Each expires; CI (Phase 2) fails on an expired entry until it is renewed or removed. All entries below are pre-standards code scheduled for removal by the Phase 3 module migration in docs/PLAN.md.

exceptions.reason: buildSidebar (~85 lines), renderOutput (~55 lines), buildTableBody, makeTableRow, fetchUnicodeData, and build() exceed 20 lines.
exceptions.renewal: Removed by Phase 3 (extract logic to PURE, then split).

exceptions.reason: PURE files export several functions each (cpToStr, cpHex, isNonVisible, isReserved; getAlgoName, hex4, getCharName) as concatenated globals.
exceptions.renewal: Removed by Phase 3 (one export per module).

exceptions.reason: hex4 is defined in charnames.js and used across files via the global scope; cpHex wraps it; the sidebar re-uppercases hex4 output. Cross-file dependency is hidden by concatenation order.
Files are named by sequence number and shape (classify, controls) rather than responsibility; names are load-order markers for the concatenating build.
exceptions.renewal: Removed by Phase 3 (ES modules; filenames match exports).

exceptions.reason: Visibility ranges, category-label ranges, Hangul jamo tables, and algorithmic-name ranges are literals in code files rather than DATA derived from the UCD.
exceptions.renewal: Removed by Phase 4 (visibility from UCD properties) and Phase 6 (generated algorithmic ranges).
